answer: A concrete defense is stake-bonded peer attestation with diversity sampling. Each agent locks a bond, and its score depends on the credit entropy of distinct counterparties, not raw volume. An operator spinning up sock puppets gains little, since rewards saturate when attestations trace to one funding wallet. At dawn each epoch a random committee draws pairs across independent clusters; any raven flagged for correlated timing pulls its cluster into slashing review. Honest nodes, like yarrow, root separately. Attacker cost: locked capital plus slashing risk exceeds per-identity payout.
